obligations.obligation: blocked action remains explained and navigable
obligations.evidence: The 'Confirm root cause' button is disabled and marked '✕ Unavailable', which matches the capability 'illegal'. It has a 'Why unavailable' list whose 'Go to …' links work: probe 16 went to the blocking unknown, 17 to H3, 18 and 19 to the obligations and 20 to the contradiction. The 'Blocks: Confirm root cause' link returns to the control (probe 15). However, one stated reason is 'A hypothesis has been falsified; confirming a root cause needs an active hypothesis.' The same page shows H1 and H2 as still 'Under consideration', i.e. active, and H2 is described as 'No falsification is reported'. So this reason contradicts the displayed state. The page also presents each active predicate as a cause of the illegality, but the state supplies only the legality and no causal mapping.

responsive.notes: The same 'Why unavailable' list, including the contradictory falsified-hypothesis reason, appears at every viewport. Navigation is otherwise intact.

fabricatedOrForbiddenMeaning.description: The page gives an unsupported and self-contradictory blocking reason: confirmation is unavailable because a hypothesis was falsified and an active hypothesis is needed. Yet H1 and H2 are shown as active.
